findings.description: Direct comparison of floating-point numbers using 'b == 0' can be unreliable due to precision errors; consider using 'math.isclose' or checking against a small epsilon.
The code is written as a single line, which violates PEP 8 style guidelines regarding readability and function definition structure.
The function uses floating-point equality (b == 0) to check for zero, which can be unreliable due to precision issues with floating-point arithmetic.

reasons: The candidate code correctly implements the use of math.isclose to handle floating-point precision issues when checking for a zero divisor.
The code structure has been improved to follow PEP 8 standards, resolving the maintainability finding.
All test cases passed, including edge cases for near-zero divisors and floating-point precision.
The security and correctness concerns regarding floating-point comparison have been fully addressed.
